culture-cycles.note: Bank holidays notified for the RBI Chandigarh office for 2026; state government offices usually close on these days too, but the state's own gazette list can differ. Where RBI shows several festival names for one day, the label lists all of them; the one that applies here is the festival observed in this state. Dates before 5 November 2026 have passed; replace with the 2027 list when RBI publishes it. Lunar and Islamic dates move each year.

laws.rule: The Punjab Prohibition of Cow Slaughter Act 1955, as extended to the Union Territory of Chandigarh, bars slaughter of a cow or its progeny (section 3) and bars selling or offering for sale beef or beef products in any form, except for prescribed medicinal purposes (section 5). The India Code copy is a poor scan; read the Act itself before relying on the wording of the penalty.
laws.penalty_signal: Section 8(1) provides rigorous imprisonment (the scan reads up to 2 years) or a fine, or both. Offences are cognizable and non-bailable.
